findings.title: Native class lookup receives serialized hash instead of BlockHash
findings.scenario: Every reader step calls native getContract with {hash: string}. Pinned native resolver expects BlockHash.equals; this is the same independently reproduced boundary as withdrawal-778e. Current node double checks truthiness and masks it.
findings.repair: Retain actual header.hash() BlockHash in memory for native lookup while persisting canonical hex only; test actual native resolver and unchanged canonical checks.

findings.scope: Required composition before existing wallet privateStore wiring
findings.title: Preference cache domain prevents existing wallet backup export
findings.scenario: After writing one same-owner ROLLING_PREFERENCES_V1 encrypted slot to existing privateStore, createJournalBackup.exportRecords rejects BB_JOURNAL_INVALID because domain is absent from strict allowlist. Actual AES-GCM slot/backup reproduction confirmed empty export before write, failure after.
findings.repair: Add strict exact preference scope/domain backup support with export/restore/conflict tests, or explicitly separate reconstructible cache storage. Never silently skip unknown same-owner records.

checks.test: Actual encrypted-slot plus existing backup in-memory storage composition
checks.result: Export empty before write; BB_JOURNAL_INVALID after preference domain record
